newsitem.title: USA: Lockheed Martin gets $1.59 billion satellite contract.
newsitem.headline: Lockheed Martin gets $1.59 billion satellite contract.

text.p: The Lockheed Martin Missiles and Space division of Lockheed Martin Corp. has received a $1.59 billion defence contract for development of new satellites to detect missile launches, the Air Force said Friday.
The contract is for development and delivery of five high-orbit satellites with infra-red detection capability as well as a ground system and two special space payloads, the Air Force said.
Work on the satellites and other equipment is expected to be completed in the year 2006.
Lockheed Martin is the nation's biggest defence contractor.
